extraction_notes: Identity verified: p. 1 prints the base device name MMBT3904, the marking diagram prints 1AM, and the equivalent circuit explicitly identifies an NPN transistor. The supplied catalog MPN MMBT3904 1AM is therefore represented without changing the requested MPN.
Pin identity on p. 1 is SOT-23 pin 1 = base, pin 2 = emitter, pin 3 = collector.

All tabulated electrical characteristics are specified at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise stated. The three available hFE rows are guaranteed minimums: 100 at IC = 10 mA, 60 at IC = 50 mA, and 40 at IC = 100 mA, all at VCE = 1 V. The 10 mA row also prints a maximum of 300 and the classification table prints a 100-300 range; these bounds were not converted to typical values.
Only one VCE(sat)/VBE(sat) table row is published, at IC = 50 mA and IB = 5 mA. Both values are guaranteed maxima; no second saturation row was invented.

The scalar fT row is a 300 MHz minimum at VCE = 20 V and IC = 100 mA with measurement frequency f = 100 MHz. The p. 3 fT plot is a separate typical characteristic at Ta = 25 degC and was digitized separately.

Cobo and Cibo have no numeric electrical-characteristics table entries in this PDF, so the required scalar specs remain null. Their p. 3 typical capacitance curves were digitized with the printed 1 MHz and zero-terminal-current conditions.

Curve points are manual digitizations of visible plotted lines on p. 3. Printed mA, mV, pF, and MHz axes were converted to SI units; logarithmic versus linear axis scales and stated test conditions are preserved. Digitized points are approximate graph readings, not interpolated table values.

The p. 1 maximum-ratings table also gives VCBO = 60 V, VEBO = 6 V, IC = 200 mA, PC = 200 mW, RthetaJA = 625 degC/W, Tj = 150 degC, and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC; the strict specs schema has no fields for these additional bounds.
